content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Crypto payment gateways are decentralized solutions that allow digital creators to accept cryptocurrency for their products. Unlike traditional platforms such as Gumroad, which charges 10% on each sale, crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge only 0.5%. This significant fee difference can have a major impact on your bottom line, particularly for creators making numerous sales. For instance, if you sell 100 products a month at $97 each, switching from Gumroad to NOWPayments could save you $921 per month. This model not only reduces costs but also empowers creators by providing complete control over their financial transactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind crypto payment gateways is built on blockchain technology, which enables secure and transparent transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, ensuring that it is verifiable and immutable. The moment a payment is confirmed, a webhook automatically triggers, delivering the purchased digital product instantly. This process requires minimal overhead, allowing creators to focus on their content rather than payment logistics. Furthermore, using platforms like Cloudflare or Google Apps Script for backend logic ensures that the entire architecture remains cost-effective and resilient against outages.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment options are limited or completely inaccessible. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products in countries like Ghana, Kenya, or Venezuela, leveraging a crypto payment gateway can open new avenues for income. The architecture is ideal for anyone seeking full ownership of their sales process without reliance on subscription-based platforms or third-party intermediaries. This sovereignty in commerce is essential for creators who want to establish a sustainable online presence.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively deploy a crypto payment gateway for your digital products, you need several key components. First, a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides a reliable platform for your storefront. Next, backend logic can be managed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For payment processing, NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, while order storage can be handled by Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, file delivery can be automated using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Together, these tools create a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your crypto payment gateway, start by selecting a hosting service such as GitHub Pages. Set up your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and order fulfillment. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing, ensuring you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders securely. Finally, automate file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This straightforward approach enables you to establish a fully functional online store with minimal overhead.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This platform allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you keep more of your earnings due to lower transaction fees. By employing a combination of hosting services and backend logic, you can create a robust online store that operates independently of restricted payment platforms.
Secure cryptocurrency transactions empower creators with financial autonomy.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads in a sovereign manner, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all six blueprints and seven templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online using a crypto payment gateway such as NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies without reliance on traditional banking systems, providing flexibility and lower fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to use a crypto payment gateway combined with a self-hosted storefront. This setup minimizes costs and maximizes your earnings.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up a self-hosted store that utilizes a crypto payment gateway. This infrastructure enables you to keep more of your revenues and maintain full control.
What are the advantages of using a crypto payment gateway?

Using a crypto payment gateway offers lower transaction fees, faster payment processing, and greater ownership of your sales process. It also provides access to a global customer base without the usual restrictions.
How can I ensure instant delivery of digital products?

To ensure instant delivery of digital products, automate the delivery process using tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Coupled with a webhook from your payment processor, this guarantees timely access for customers.
Automate your digital delivery to enhance customer satisfaction.
